The Hub Power Company (HUBC)

The Hub Power Company is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange under HUBC. This note says what the business is and which documents to read. It is not a recommendation and it does not publish a price.

The business

Hub Power is a listed power producer. Its story is plants, the contracts and tariffs that pay them, and the fuel and financing attached to them, plus interests in other power projects the report describes. It is not an exploration company, even though both can be sensitive to energy policy.

Income investors often study Hub Power because power producers have historically been discussed as dividend payers. “Historically” is not “next quarter.” The dividend you can plan around is the one in the latest notice, with its book closure, and only if you held the shares for that closure.

This page does not quote a live price, a dividend amount, or a target. Those figures belong in the company’s own notices, your broker, and — for a fund — the manager’s statement and MUFAP’s published NAV. PSX Tracker is not a broker and does not place orders.

What the accounts are really about

Look for capacity payments versus energy payments if the report splits them, for receivables from the power purchaser, and for debt taken on to build plants. A profit that sits in receivables has not arrived as cash. Circular-debt discussions in the director’s report are there for that reason.

Project companies and associates may sit beside the parent. The consolidated total and the standalone total answer different questions. Know which one you are reading when you quote a profit.

In a personal ledger

Treat each dividend as its own cash event with withholding recorded beside it. Treat a bonus, if one is declared, as a share event that changes quantity and cost per share, not as cash.

Do not set a tracker cost equal to a “fair value” you estimated. Cost is what you paid. Value is an opinion you can keep in a note. Mixing them makes the unrealized figure meaningless.

Common questions

Does this page show the live HUBC price?

No. Publishing a scraped quote would copy someone else’s market data. Open your broker for the price you can trade, or the app after you sign in, for the research view.

Is HUBC a buy?

No. This site does not rank or recommend shares. Read the latest accounts and decide for yourself.

How should I record HUBC I already own?

Enter each fill with its date, quantity, price, and fees, then reconcile the quantity to your broker or CDC statement. Dividends go in as dividends, not as new deposits.
